column1: # Traceability of the OTLP logs wire model (vendored protobufs) into the
# in-memory domain model and the SQLite columns it lands in.
#  * every field of the messages below is classified by at least one row,
#  * every row names a field that exists in the vendored protos,
#  * every stored column of the migrated schema is produced by some row,
#  * every `loss_counter` value exists in the ingress sources and every counter
#    reason emitted by the ingress appears here.
# One proto field may fan out to several rows when persistence denormalizes it
# (a scope's name, version and attributes all land on every log_event row).
#   mapped     same value reaches storage (renamed or not)
#   re-encoded same information, different representation (JSON, BLOB, text)
#   coerced    normalized per spec, losing the original form
#   dropped    intentionally discarded, no column and no counter
#   structural grouping wrapper with no stored counterpart of its own
#   derived    computed by the sink; may still be derived from a proto field
# Column   = the stored column the value reaches (fidelity-matrix.md lists them).
